episodes.title: Sibling Showdown - Would You Rather
episodes.summary: We're switching things up and bringing you a fun episode full of games, laughs, wild scenarios, and some interesting decisions! This time, Corbin and Carter go head-to-head playing a few different games: 🎮 Would You Rather? – Tough…
episodes.notes_html:
We're switching things up and bringing you a fun episode full of games, laughs, wild scenarios, and some interesting decisions!

This time, Corbin and Carter go head-to-head playing a few different games:

🎮 Would You Rather? – Tough choices and some interesting debates.

🌎 World Swap – What would happen if we switched worlds?

🦸 Superpower Punishments – Superpowers sound cool until there's a catch!

🧞 3 Genie Wishes – If we could have ANY 3 wishes, what would we choose?


And here's where YOU come in...

At the end, we each give our thoughts on what we think are the best World to live in, best Superpower to have and the best 3 genie wishes, and we want YOU to decide whose choices are better! Let us know in the comments: WHO WON?

episodes.title: Queen
episodes.summary: Queen is a British rock band formed in 1970 in London by Freddie Mercury (lead singer) Brian May (guitar) and Roger Taylor (drums) later joined by John Deacon (bass). they were initially called Smile, until Freddie decided they needed a…
episodes.notes_html:
Queen is a British rock band formed in 1970 in London by Freddie Mercury (lead singer) Brian May (guitar) and Roger Taylor (drums) later joined by John Deacon (bass). they were initially called Smile, until Freddie decided they needed a more extravagant name such as Queen. Their earliest works were more heavy metal inspired but gradually formed into rock/pop. Come learn how they began, as well as how they became one of the biggest/best-selling bands of their time!

episodes.title: Bonus blackbear/Mansionz
episodes.summary: Blackbear has a lot of remixes/features on some great songs and we wanted to share some of our favorite ones, for example this one probably being our favorite, it’s his feature on Hoodie Allen's track “Champagne and Pools” Blackbear sings…
episodes.notes_html:
Blackbear has a lot of remixes/features on some great songs and we wanted to share some of our favorite ones, for example this one probably being our favorite, it’s his feature on Hoodie Allen's track “Champagne and Pools” Blackbear sings the chorus, and he adds so much to each song he’s on. In our opinion he makes each song better!

Later in this episode we also talk about Blackbear’s band/album shared with Mike Posner, known best from his hit song “I Took A Pill In Ibiza” They met while cowriting Justin Beibers song “Boyfriend” and from that, they  became super close!

Mansionz started in 2017 They were looking for an artistic escape. So they decided to form a new creative outlet together as a conceptual duo and that is how “Mansionz“ was born!

episodes.notes_html: Today we discuss the #1 man on Spotify right now, Ed Sheeran. Love him or hate him, Ed Sheeran has shown his expertise in music, making constant hits since his upcoming. He also is a fantastic songwriter, writing for artists such as One Direction, Justin Bieber, and Taylor Swift! With his following of about 78 million monthly listeners, he has amassed more than 15 billion streams. His "Shape of You" has passed 3 billion streams, being the first to do so making it the most popular song in the world (on Spotify). If you've ever wanted to know a little more about Ed Sheeran and his rise to fame, come join us!
